text: What if the internet disappeared for five seconds?
You're in Times Square. It's Friday night.
All around you, invisible data is flying. Every phone. Every screen. Every card tap.
Nearly eight hundred thousand Google searches never happen.
About twenty million emails freeze in mid-air.
Tens of thousands of card payments just hang.
And every phone in this square says the same thing: no connection.
Five seconds. So what would you miss first? Comment below.
